title: I made my own navlink!!!
excerpt:
I just made my own navlink widget, called RainyLink! This widget rotates randomly between all members of the network every 10 seconds. It comes in two standard sizes: 88x31 and 176x62.

How it works:
1. You grab the code from the RainyLink tab in Start > webring.exe.
(or go to https://rainy351.nekoweb.org/#rainylink)
2. Put the widget on your site.
3. Message me in the Guestbook (or mail) with your site link and button image.
4. I add you to the JSON, and boom — you're in the global rotation on every site in the network.
